description: Defines interfaces and structures for SDR Radio Unit executor mappers, including sector and overall mapper classes, configurations for different baseband setups, and factory functions for creating mappers.

classes.name: ru_sdr_sector_executor_mapper
classes.description: Interface for accessing sector-specific SDR executor components, including downlink, uplink, PRACH, transmitter, and receiver executors.

classes.name: ru_sdr_executor_mapper
classes.description: Interface for managing multiple sector mappers and overall radio executor, including access to sector mappers and radio housekeeping executor.

methods.name: get_sector_mapper
methods.description: Retrieves the sector executor mapper for a specified sector index.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Provides array-like access to sector mappers by index.
